expertise.en_intro: Smart toys sit at the intersection of toy safety and electronics compliance — EN71 / ASTM F963 and radio plus battery rules apply to the very same unit.
expertise.zh_intro: 智能玩具同时受玩具安全与电子合规约束：EN71 / ASTM F963 与射频、电池法规都落在同一件产品上。
process: Voice, screen and plush-electronic hybrids are integrated on one PCBA; placement drives both EMC behaviour and small-parts safety.
语音、屏幕与毛绒电子混合结构集成在同一块 PCBA 上，布局同时影响 EMC 与小零件安全。
Firmware is locked before safety testing — a late voice-library change can force a full retest of the radio module.
固件需在安规测试前冻结；语音库后期变更可能导致射频模块重新全套测试。
Battery compartments use captive screws and tool-access-only covers to satisfy accessible-battery clauses.
电池仓采用防脱螺丝与需工具开启的盖板，满足电池不可触及条款。
buyer: Fix the age grading first: 0–3, 3–8 and 8+ trigger different small-parts, torque and chemical migration limits.
先定年龄分级：0–3 / 3–8 / 8+ 对应不同的小零件、扭力与化学迁移限值。
Request EN71-1/2/3, ASTM F963, CPSIA plus CE RED / FCC and UN38.3 as one test plan, not separate orders.
把 EN71-1/2/3、ASTM F963、CPSIA 与 CE RED / FCC、UN38.3 合并成一份测试计划，不要分开下单。
Confirm who owns the voice content and firmware source before tooling; content licensing is separate from hardware.
开模前确认语音内容与固件源码归属；内容授权与硬件是两回事。
qc: Small-parts torque and tension tests after drop and impact conditioning, not only on fresh samples.
跌落与冲击预处理后再做小零件扭力/拉力测试，不能只测新样。
Saliva and sweat simulant wipe tests on printed decals and painted surfaces; check for phthalate and heavy-metal migration.
对贴纸与喷涂面做唾液、汗液模拟擦拭，并检测邻苯与重金属迁移。
faq: Can one SKU be certified for both the EU and US?
Yes, but the test plan must be written for both upfront; retesting after a failed US children's-product clause is far more expensive than a dual-market plan.
一个 SKU 能同时做欧盟和美国认证吗？
可以，但测试计划必须一开始就按双市场编写；美国儿童用品条款不合格后返测，成本远高于双市场并行。
Do you handle plush plus electronics in one shipment?
Yes. Plush shells, PCBA and packaging are consolidated into one export document package with the toy and electronics certificates kept together.
毛绒与电子件能合并出货吗？
可以。毛绒外壳、PCBA 与包材合并为一套出口单证，玩具与电子证书随货同行。

expertise.en_intro: Tablet and phone PCBA is a high-density interconnect job: BGA, eMMC/UFS and display bonding tolerances decide yield long before assembly starts.
expertise.zh_intro: 平板与手机 PCBA 属于高密度互连：BGA、eMMC/UFS 与显示绑定的公差，在投产前就决定了良率。
process: HDI stack-up and via-in-pad design are reviewed in DFM before Gerber release to avoid delamination during reflow.
Gerber 放行前在 DFM 阶段评审 HDI 叠层与盘中孔设计，避免回流焊分层。
eMMC/UFS firmware pre-programming and SoC matching are verified on a pilot lot before the full BOM is committed.
eMMC/UFS 预烧录固件与 SoC 匹配需在小批试产验证后，才锁定整份 BOM。
Display FPC bonding and backlight driver current are checked as a paired station to prevent mura and early dimming.
显示 FPC 绑定与背光驱动电流在同一工位成对检验，避免 mura 与早期亮度衰减。
buyer: Send a complete BOM with approved alternates and lifecycle status — EOL memory parts are the most common delay.
提供含已批准替代料与生命周期状态的完整 BOM；停产存储料是最常见的延期原因。
Specify ICT / FCT coverage and the acceptable AOI false-call rate in the RFQ, not after first article.
在询价中写明 ICT / FCT 覆盖率与可接受的 AOI 误报率，不要等首件后再谈。
Clarify whether the display module and battery are consigned or turnkey; liability for dead pixels must be assigned.
明确显示屏模组与电池是客供还是统购；亮点/坏点责任必须事先划分。
qc: SPI solder-paste inspection plus X-ray on all BGA sites; AOI alone cannot see head-in-pillow defects.
SPI 锡膏检测 + 全部 BGA 点位 X 光；AOI 无法发现枕头效应（head-in-pillow）缺陷。
FCT with thermal soak and a documented yield Pareto; any lot below the agreed first-pass yield is held.
FCT 含热浸泡并出具良率 Pareto 图；低于约定直通率的批次暂缓放行。
faq: Do you support consigned components?
Yes. Consigned SoCs, memory and displays are logged by lot code, stored separately and reconciled against yield reports at shipment.
支持客供料吗？
支持。客供 SoC、存储与显示屏按批次码登记、分区存放，出货时与良率报告一并核对。
What is a realistic first-pass yield for a tablet PCBA pilot?
A controlled pilot typically lands in the low-to-mid 90s percent; we agree the target in writing before the run and report the Pareto by defect class.
平板 PCBA 试产直通率多少算合理？
受控试产通常落在 90% 出头到中段；目标在投产前书面约定，并按缺陷类别出具 Pareto 报告。

expertise.en_intro: Wearables fail in the field on sealing and sensor accuracy, not on the PCB — IP rating and optical calibration are the two gates that matter.

PPG 光学与加速度计位置需贴合外壳曲率定位；偏移 0.5 mm 就会改变心率信号质量。
IP67/IP68 sealing is achieved with gasket compression plus ultrasonic welding or adhesive bonding, validated by air-leak test.
IP67/IP68 靠密封圈压缩配合超声焊接或胶封实现，并以气密性检测验证。
Strap material, quick-release lug and skin-contact coatings are qualified together for nickel release and sweat corrosion.

buyer: Fix the sensor feature set (SpO2, ECG, GPS) at RFQ — each addition changes the BOM, power budget and regulatory class.
询价阶段锁定传感器功能（血氧 / ECG / GPS），每加一项都会改变 BOM、功耗与法规类别。
Ask for a water-bath and thermal-cycling report on production units, not just a prototype IP certificate.
索取量产机的浸水与冷热循环报告，而不只是样机的 IP 证书。
Confirm charger pogo-pin plating and magnet polarity if you plan a shared dock across SKUs.
若计划多 SKU 共用充电座，需确认 pogo-pin 镀层与磁铁极性。
qc: 100% air-leak test after final assembly; sample units go through 1 m immersion and 48 h humidity soak.
总装后 100% 气密检测，抽样做 1 m 浸水与 48 h 湿热。
Optical sensor calibration against a reference device on a sampled basis, with drift logged after burn-in.
按抽样用基准设备校准光学传感器，并记录老化后的漂移量。
faq: Can I reuse an existing enclosure design for my brand?
Yes for ODM-derived tooling, provided the sealing geometry is re-validated; we re-run the air-leak and drop tests rather than relying on the original certificate.
可以复用现有外壳设计做自有品牌吗？
ODM 衍生模具可以，但密封结构需重新验证；我们会重跑气密与跌落测试，不沿用原证书。

process: We work from your drawings, Gerber/BOM and specification; DFM feedback is issued in writing before any tooling or fixture is committed.

Engineering change notes are version-controlled: a revision change triggers a new first article, never an informal swap.

buyer: Provide a complete drawing package with tolerance scheme, material specs and acceptance criteria — not a reference photo alone.

Sign an NDA and state who owns tooling, firmware and any derived IP before the deposit.
付定金前签 NDA，并写明模具、固件与衍生 IP 的归属。
Agree the inspection level (AQL or full check) and who pays for third-party testing.
约定检验水平（AQL 或全检）与第三方测试费用承担方。
qc: First-article inspection report with dimension-by-dimension results against the drawing revision.
按图纸版本出具逐尺寸首件检验报告。
In-process checks at the agreed control points, with a by-process photo gallery and recorded shop-floor video available remotely.
按约定控制点做过程检验，并提供分工序照片库与车间录像供远程查验。
faq: Who owns the tooling in a build-to-print program?
Tooling ownership is agreed in writing before the deposit; the tool is tagged with your project code and stored at the contracted workshop, with a photo and location record.
按图 OEM 的模具归谁？
模具归属在付定金前书面约定；模具挂贵方项目代码、存放于签约车间，并留存照片与位置记录。
Can you sign our NDA before we share drawings?
Yes. An NDA is executed before any drawing, Gerber or BOM is exchanged, and documents are shared only with the named engineering contacts.
能在提供图纸前签 NDA 吗？
可以。交换任何图纸、Gerber 或 BOM 之前先签 NDA，且文件仅对指定工程联系人开放。

buyer: Decide early which layers you must own (housing tool, firmware source, packaging artwork) versus which can stay shared.

Ask for the reference platform's existing certificate list and its expiry dates.
索取参考平台现有证书清单及有效期。
Clarify exclusivity: a shared platform is generally non-exclusive unless a tooling buyout is agreed.
明确排他性：共用平台通常非独家，除非约定买断模具。
qc: Golden sample approval covers ID, colour, logo placement and UI language before production release.
量产放行前对 ID、颜色、logo 位置与界面语言做签样确认。
Reliability tests carry over from the reference platform; delta tests are run only on the changed layers.
可靠性测试沿用参考平台记录，仅对变更层做差异验证。
faq: How is ODM different from OEM for tooling cost?
ODM reuses an existing platform so there is little or no new platform tooling; you pay for custom housing, artwork and any delta testing rather than a full ground-up programme.
ODM 与 OEM 的模具成本差在哪？
ODM 复用现有平台，几乎无全新平台模具；费用集中在外壳、包材与差异测试，而非从零开发。
Can I later move an ODM product to a build-to-print model?
Yes. We document the platform BOM and interfaces at handover so a later transfer to your own drawings is possible without re-qualifying the whole supply chain.
ODM 产品后续能转按图 OEM 吗？
可以。交接时提供平台 BOM 与接口文档，后续转自有图纸无需重新认证整条供应链。

OEM（按图）从贵方图纸起步；设计与通常模具归贵方，开发周期较长。
ODM starts from a qualified reference platform; the supplier owns the base design and its certificates, and you customise agreed layers.
ODM 从已验证参考平台起步；基础设计及证书归供方，贵方定制约定层级。
Hybrid models exist: bought-out housing tooling on a shared platform is the most common middle path.
存在混合模式：共用平台 + 买断外壳模具，是最常见的中间路线。
buyer: Ask three questions: who owns the tool, who holds the certificates, and can the BOM be transferred.
问三件事：模具归谁、证书在谁名下、BOM 能否转移。
If time to market dominates, ODM; if differentiation and IP control dominate, OEM.
上市速度优先选 ODM；差异化与 IP 管控优先选 OEM。
Put the answer in the supply agreement, not only in the quotation.
把答案写进供货协议，而不只是报价单。
qc: For OEM, verify the first article against your drawing revision; for ODM, verify the delta layers only.
OEM 按贵方图纸版本验首件；ODM 只验变更层。
Check the certificate holder name on every document — it must match the party that will support a market audit.
核对每份证书上的持证人名称，须与将来应对市场审查的主体一致。
faq: Which is cheaper for a first order?
ODM is usually cheaper and faster for a first order because platform tooling and certification already exist; OEM costs more upfront but gives full control of the design and supply chain.
首单哪种更便宜？
首单通常 ODM 更省更快，因平台模具与认证已存在；OEM 前期投入高，但换来设计与供应链的完全控制。
Can I switch from ODM to OEM later?
Yes, if the platform BOM, interfaces and test limits are documented at handover; we provide that file list so a later build-to-print transfer does not restart qualification.
后续能从 ODM 转 OEM 吗？
可以，前提是交接时留存平台 BOM、接口与测试限值文档；我们提供该文件清单，使后续转按图无需重做认证。

process: Check the business licence, registered capital, legal representative and whether the entity actually holds the claimed factory.

buyer: Request a by-process photo gallery, a recorded shop-floor video and a live inspection by appointment.

related_qa: What are the basic steps to import from China?
Define your spec, find and verify a supplier, quote and sample, contract on the right Incoterms, run QC, arrange freight and customs clearance, then pay the balance after QC passes.
Which Incoterm should a beginner use?
FOB Shenzhen is common: the seller delivers to the port, you control freight and insurance. EXW shifts all logistics to you; DDP shifts everything to the seller but costs more.
How do I estimate landed cost?
Unit price plus freight, insurance, import duty, VAT and last-mile delivery. Always get the HS code right — it drives duty.
How do I find and verify a supplier?
Start on B2B platforms, then verify the operating entity, business license and a recorded shop-floor video. A buying office can do this on your behalf.
What documents do I need to clear customs?
Commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, HS code and a clean packing list. Your supplier or freight forwarder prepares these.

related_qa: How do I verify a Chinese manufacturer is real?

Confirm the uniform social credit code on the business license, match it to the operating entity, and request a recorded shop-floor video and certificate wall. A legitimate factory will provide these.
What are the red flags of a scam?
No verifiable business license, refusal to show the factory, pressure to prepay 100%, prices far below market, and only communicating through a platform chat with no company identity.
Should I use a third-party inspection?
For any order of meaningful value, yes. Independent inspectors (SGS, TUV, AQSIQ-licensed local firms) confirm quantity, quality and packaging before you release the balance.
How should I structure payment safely?
Never prepay 100%. A common safe structure is T/T 30% deposit to start, 70% after QC pass and before shipment.
Is a trading company safer than a factory?
Not inherently. What matters is verifiable identity and a single accountable party. A coordinator that discloses its operating entity and vetted network is safer than an anonymous factory.

A mismatch between the licence name, the bank account name and the invoice entity. That single inconsistency should stop a deposit until it is explained in writing.

执照名称、银行账户名与开票主体三者不一致。出现这一处不一致，就应在书面澄清前暂停付定金。
